comment: Documents both storydoc libraries must read AND write identically. Each case is run by tests/server/test_storydoc.py and tests/extension/storydoc/model.test.ts: `text` must parse to `cells`, and re-serialising must produce `dumped` byte for byte. Add a case here and both languages are held to it.

cases.name: an empty document has no cells
a document of only blank lines has no cells
a marker opens a cell and the text below it is the source
cases.text:
<!-- cell: chapter title="The First Night" -->

The lantern had gone out.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: chapter title="The First Night" -->

The lantern had gone out.

cases.name: a marker is read whatever spacing it was written with
a document opening with a marker has no empty leading cell
cases.text:
<!-- cell: contents -->

<!-- cell: chapter title="One" -->

Prose.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: contents -->

<!-- cell: chapter title="One" -->

Prose.

cases.name: a cell with no body is kept, because its kind is the point
an unknown kind is carried through untouched
cases.text:
<!-- cell: epigraph attribution="Anon" -->

A line of verse.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: epigraph attribution="Anon" -->

A line of verse.

cases.name: several attributes are read in order
cases.text:
<!-- cell: cover src="art/cover.jpg" alt="The cover" -->

![The cover](art/cover.jpg)
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: cover src="art/cover.jpg" alt="The cover" -->

![The cover](art/cover.jpg)

cases.name: a quote inside an attribute survives escaping
a backslash inside an attribute survives escaping
blank lines inside a cell are the author's and are kept
an ordinary html comment is not a marker
cases.text:
<!-- cell: chapter title="One" -->

<!-- a note to myself -->
Prose.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: chapter title="One" -->

<!-- a note to myself -->
Prose.

cases.name: a part opens a run of chapters and carries only its name
cases.text:

<!-- cell: chapter title="The First Night" -->

<!-- cell: part title="Book Two" -->

<!-- cell: chapter title="After" -->

It ended worse.
